analyst.summary: Himadri is the domestic leader in coal-tar-pitch and carbon materials and is investing to move into higher-value specialty chemicals and EV battery materials, a genuine growth optionality on India's localization push. Recent quarters show strong revenue and profit growth, though a chunk of the latest quarter's profit jump came from a one-off-looking 'other income' item, and debt has risen to fund new capacity that has yet to prove itself commercially. We rate it a Hold: the core business is executing well, but the battery-materials growth leg is still a promise rather than a delivered result, and the current valuation already gives some credit for that promise.
